mapper.select: SELECT C.COM_NAME_LOC as compyName, -- 고객사명 (ICOMCMPY에서 직접 조회) G.PO_NO as poNo, -- 발주번호 G.BUYER_ITEM_NO as itemCode, -- 품목코드 G.DESCRIPTION as itemName, -- 품명 G.SPECIFICATION as spec, -- 규격 G.ITEM_QTY as receiptQty, -- 입고수량 G.AGENT_PRICE as receiptPrice, -- 입고단가 (VAT 계산 제거) G.AGENT_ITEM_AMT as receiptAmount, -- 입고금액 (VAT 계산 제거) TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(K.ISSUE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY.MM.DD') as confirmDate, -- 확정일 TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(G.GR_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY.MM.DD') as receiptDate, -- 입고일 G.BUYER, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY/MM/DD') as ORDER_DATE, -- 발주일 DEPT.TEXT1 as PURCHASER_DEPT, -- 요청부서 (ICOMCOD2에서 부서명) PRDT.ADD_USER_NAME as REQUESTER_NAME -- 요청자 (ICOMPRDT에서 요청자명) FROM KEPTAPDT K INNER JOIN ICOMGRDT G ON K.TAX_BILL_NO = G.AP_TAX_BILL_NO INNER JOIN ICOMCMPY C ON G.BUYER = C.COM_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMPOHD POHD ON POHD.BUYER = G.BUYER AND POHD.PO_NO = G.PO_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMPODT PODT ON G.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND G.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND G.PO_SEQ = PODT.PO_SEQ LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMPRDT PRDT ON PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ = PRDT.PR_SEQ LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMCOD2 DEPT ON PRDT.BUYER = DEPT.COMPANY_CODE AND PRDT.ADD_USER_DEPT = DEPT.CODE AND DEPT.TYPE = 'C001' WHERE K.TAX_BILL_NO = #{taxBillNo} AND K.STATUS <> 'D' AND G.STATUS <> 'D' AND C.STATUS <> 'D' ORDER BY G.PO_NO, G.PO_SEQ
